title: [Setup] Configure JSII language targets for all packages
description:
Add Python, Java, .NET C#, and Go JSII targets to every package.json in the monorepo. Re-run projen to regenerate managed files. Targets follow JSII naming conventions:
- Python: distName sevenpico.<package-slug>, module sevenpico.<package_slug>
- Java: groupId com.sevenpico, artifactId <package-slug>
- dotnet: namespace SevenPico.<PascalCaseName>
- go: moduleName github.com/sevenpico/cdk-constructs/

Verify each package builds cleanly with `npx jsii` after targets are added. This task is a prerequisite for all construct example tasks involving non-TypeScript languages.
